intended_object: The image in M of an unoriented smooth embedded circle, i.e. the subset f(S¹) ⊆ M for any representative embedding f of the class of smooth embeddings S¹ → M modulo orientation reversal. This comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The class `UnorientedSmoothCircleEmbedding` is the quotient of smooth circle embeddings by the relation "f = g or f = g.reverse". `range` lifts `Set.range` to this quotient. The lift is well defined because reversing an embedding means precomposing it with the diffeomorphism x ↦ x⁻¹ of the circle, which does not change its image (`range_reverse`). On every class, the definition therefore returns the image f(S¹) of any representative f, which is exactly the embedded circle as a subset of M. Neither the definition nor `SmoothCircleEmbedding` puts unnecessary restrictions on the setting: the ambient manifold has an arbitrary real model with corners. Mathlib has no notion of unoriented circle embeddings, so there is no counterpart.
